definitions.explanation: A written or printed document, especially one with official, legal, or formal significance.

examples.japanese: {公式|こうしき}{文書|ぶんしょ}を{作成|さくせい}する。
{機密|きみつ}{文書|ぶんしょ}が{流出|りゅうしゅつ}した。
{社内|しゃない}{文書|ぶんしょ}はすべてデジタル{化|か}されて{管理|かんり}されている。
examples.english: All internal documents are digitized and managed electronically.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal term for written documents, especially those with official or institutional significance. More formal than {書類|しょるい} (documents, paperwork) and {文章|ぶんしょう} (writing, text, prose). Note the difference in reading: {文書|ぶんしょ} vs. {文章|ぶんしょう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {公式|こうしき}{文書|ぶんしょ}: official document
- {機密|きみつ}{文書|ぶんしょ}: classified document
- {文書|ぶんしょ}{管理|かんり}: document management
- {文書|ぶんしょ}{偽造|ぎぞう}: document forgery
- {歴史的|れきしてき}{文書|ぶんしょ}: historical document

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {書類|しょるい}: documents, paperwork (everyday business use)
- {文章|ぶんしょう}: writing, text, prose (focus on the written content)
- {資料|しりょう}: materials, documents (for reference or research)
